resolvedQuestions.answer: Pre-registered keep rule over a 31/40-drifted sample vs a weak comparator; precision 1.00, recall 0.839; replay exact.

resolvedQuestions.text: How can accuracy rise or cost fall?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Aggregation (min<0.5 TP 27 FP 0; mean<0.6 acc 0.925), payload unit fix, census read waste 8,667->82, adaptive reruns.

resolvedQuestions.text: How can the measurement be more trustworthy?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Per-kind reporting (live-only p=0.0156), kappa 0.79-1.00, per-row outcome record, comparator fix, test sign/flip paths.

resolvedQuestions.text: Where else would the judgment pay off?
resolvedQuestions.answer: specs (12,092 citing docs) via ACs and evidence citations; in-scope sk-code docs; mirrors null; classify illustrative refs first.

resolvedQuestions.text: What would a default-on integration need, cost and risk?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Reader + advisory policy; periodic cadence; frozen benchmark labels; widened requalification; per-row record; risk register.

keyFindings.title: Keep rule's own alphabet: all five checks fixed pre-run and all pass
Margin rests on a weak comparator: identifier-overlap 13/40, flag-nothing 9/40
A=35 is relative superiority: precision 26/26, recall 26/31
calls.jsonl + labels replay the published column exactly
Constructed rows are not the easy half: live 19/20 vs constructed 16/20
p=2.384e-7 is exactly 2^-22, the W/L sign test
F=3 is three 2-1 rerun splits; one supports rerun at exactly 0.5
Row set is 9 supports / 31 drifted
Model arm cheap: 121 calls, 40.9s, ~40.7k planned input tokens
Census reads 8,667 docs to find citations in 82 (0.95%)
Zero-call accuracy win: min<0.5 TP 27 FP 0; mean<0.6 acc 0.925
Payload flaw: single-line unit; 3/20 live rows carry no claim
Only new FP under mean<0.6 is live-18; strict < is load-bearing
Adaptive reruns: 12/40 in band; ~65 calls vs 121
Instruction hash/keep rule pre-registered; requalification watches only provider/model
Pooled p dominated by constructed half; each half alone passes all five checks
Binary label reliability kappa 0.793-1.000; labels sha matches report
Jev's doubtful live answers land on the live blind-rater splits
Comparator blind to same-file moved windows: 20/20 token presence
Replay needs calls.jsonl; recommend per-row outcome file
Dead citations only in the sandboxed CP-050 fixture
No tests for sign/flip paths; .state census defect live
specs holds 12,092 docs with file:line citations (7,203 outside z_archive) vs 82 in the skills tree
Neighbors check less: AC coverage proves the line exists only; catalog validator checks path only
Mirrors/root docs/repo-rules carry 1-3 line citations total; dialect is path-only refs (43,523)
41% of in-scope citations are invisible (44 ambiguous + 103 unresolved), dominated by illustrative examples
Expansion cost bounded on the model side; read side is the bottleneck; per-corpus draws
Ranked surfaces: spec AC citations, spec evidence citations, in-scope sk-code docs, hub path-only refs
Documented surface, no reader: needs a consumer and an advisory-only policy
Cost: minutes per run today; model cost flat in corpus size; periodic advisory feasible, per-commit not
Label lifecycle bottleneck: draw refusal, commit-pinned rows, human gate; frozen benchmark + re-draws
Qualification must widen beyond provider/model to instruction/rule/row hashes
A reader needs per-row outcomes and kind split; report is aggregate-only
Risk register: claim-less rows, flips, silent skips, doc-text leakage, untested branches, moving surface
Recommended shape: advisory periodic benchmark-anchored scan; expansion after illustrative classifier
